target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, native boot-context compiler

before.result: Two consecutive #exe blocks that set a global to 41 then increment it returned 41, indicating the later block ran first.

after.result: The same probe returned 42 after the lexer executed each block before reading the following token. The existing graphical GlobalVars JIT and declaration-boundary regression also passed, including terminal recovery.

limits: StreamPrint-generated source is still unsupported; this change does not establish complete #exe or AOT semantics.
Nested stream blocks, exceptions and physical Pi behavior need separate verification.
